# 1 Kings Chapter 17 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Now Elijah the Tishbite, of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall be neither dew nor rain these years, except by my word."
**2** And the word of the LORD came to him:
**3** "Depart from here and turn eastward and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.
**4** You shall drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there."
**5** So he went and did according to the word of the LORD. He went and lived by the brook Cherith that is east of the Jordan.
**6** And the ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening, and he drank from the brook.
**7** And after a while the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
**8** Then the word of the LORD came to him,
**9** "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and dwell there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to feed you."
**10** So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. And he called to her and said, "Bring me a little water in a vessel, that I may drink."
**11** And as she was going to bring it, he called to her and said, "Bring me a morsel of bread in your hand."
**12** And she said, "As the LORD your God lives, I have nothing baked, only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug. And now I am gathering a couple of sticks that I may go in and prepare it for myself and my son, that we may eat it and die."
**13** And Elijah said to her, "Do not fear; go and do as you have said. But first make me a little cake of it and bring it to me, and afterward make something for yourself and your son.
**14** For thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, 'The jar of flour shall not be spent, and the jug of oil shall not be empty, until the day that the LORD sends rain upon the earth.'"
**15** And she went and did as Elijah said. And she and he and her household ate for many days.
**16** The jar of flour was not spent, neither did the jug of oil become empty, according to the word of the LORD that he spoke by Elijah.
**17** After this the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became ill. And his illness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.
**18** And she said to Elijah, "What have you against me, O man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to remembrance and to cause the death of my son!"
**19** And he said to her, "Give me your son." And he took him from her arms and carried him up into the upper chamber where he lodged, and laid him on his own bed.
**20** And he cried to the LORD, "O LORD my God, have you brought calamity even upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by killing her son?"
**21** Then he stretched himself upon the child three times and cried to the LORD, "O LORD my God, let this child's life come into him again."
**22** And the LORD listened to the voice of Elijah. And the life of the child came into him again, and he revived.
**23** And Elijah took the child and brought him down from the upper chamber into the house and delivered him to his mother. And Elijah said, "See, your son lives."
**24** And the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in your mouth is truth."

---
## Council Notes

SOPHIA has reviewed the translations of EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic) for this chapter.

**Method**: Each verse was compared across all three translations. The LOGOS formal translation serves as the primary consensus baseline, with adjustments where EMET's literalism reveals important Hebrew features or PNEUMA's dynamic rendering better captures the original intent.

## ⚠️ Disagreement Log

**Chapter 17**: 17 verse(s) with significant divergence

### Verse 1
- **EMET**: And-Elijah the-Tishbite, from-the-settlers-of Gilead, said to-Ahab, "As-YHWH lives, the-God-of Israel, before-whom I-stand, there-shall-not be these-years dew or-rain, except by the-word-of my-mouth."
- **LOGOS**: Now Elijah the Tishbite, of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall be neither dew nor rain these years, except by my word."
- **PNEUMA**: Now Elijah, from Tishbe in Gilead, confronted Ahab: "As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives — the God I serve — there will be no dew or rain in the coming years unless I say so."
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

### Verse 2
- **EMET**: And-the-word-of YHWH came to-him, saying,
- **LOGOS**: And the word of the LORD came to him:
- **PNEUMA**: Then the LORD told Elijah,
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

### Verse 3
- **EMET**: "Go from-here and-turn eastward and-hide-yourself by-the-brook Cherith, that is before the-Jordan.
- **LOGOS**: "Depart from here and turn eastward and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.
- **PNEUMA**: "Leave here. Go east and hide by the brook Cherith, east of the Jordan.
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

### Verse 5
- **EMET**: And-he-went and-did according-to-the-word-of YHWH. And-he-went and-dwelt by-the-brook Cherith, that is before the-Jordan.
- **LOGOS**: So he went and did according to the word of the LORD. He went and lived by the brook Cherith that is east of the Jordan.
- **PNEUMA**: Elijah did what the LORD said. He went and stayed by the brook Cherith, east of the Jordan.
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

### Verse 8
- **EMET**: And-the-word-of YHWH came to-him, saying,
- **LOGOS**: Then the word of the LORD came to him,
- **PNEUMA**: Then the LORD said to him,
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

### Verse 9
- **EMET**: "Arise, go to-Zarephath, that belongs-to-Sidon, and-dwell there. Behold, I-have-commanded there a-widow woman to-provide-for-you."
- **LOGOS**: "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and dwell there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to feed you."
- **PNEUMA**: "Get up and go to Zarephath in Sidon and stay there. I have directed a widow there to provide for you."
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

### Verse 10
- **EMET**: And-he-arose and-went to-Zarephath and-came to the-entrance-of the-city, and-behold — a-widow woman there gathering sticks. And-he-called to-her and-said, "Bring to-me, please, a-little water in-a-ves...
- **LOGOS**: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. And he called to her and said, "Bring me a little water in a vessel, that I may...
- **PNEUMA**: So he went to Zarephath. When he arrived at the town gate, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called out to her, "Would you please bring me a little water in a cup so I can have a drink?"
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

### Verse 12
- **EMET**: And-she-said, "As-YHWH your-God lives, I-have-no cake — only a-handful-of flour in-the-jar and-a-little oil in-the-jug. And-behold, I am-gathering two sticks, and-I-will-go and-make-it for-me and-for-...
- **LOGOS**: And she said, "As the LORD your God lives, I have nothing baked, only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug. And now I am gathering a couple of sticks that I may go in and prepare it f...
- **PNEUMA**: She replied, "As surely as the LORD your God lives, I don't have a single piece of bread. All I have is a handful of flour in a jar and a little olive oil in a jug. I was just gathering a few sticks t...
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

### Verse 13
- **EMET**: And-Elijah said to-her, "Do-not fear. Go, do according-to-your-word. But first make for-me from-there a-small cake, and-bring-it-out to-me. And-for-you and-for-your-son you-shall-make afterward.
- **LOGOS**: And Elijah said to her, "Do not fear; go and do as you have said. But first make me a little cake of it and bring it to me, and afterward make something for yourself and your son.
- **PNEUMA**: Elijah said to her, "Don't be afraid. Go home and do as you planned. But first, make a small loaf for me and bring it out. Then make something for yourself and your son.
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

### Verse 14
- **EMET**: For thus says YHWH, the-God-of Israel: 'The-jar-of flour shall-not be-finished and-the-jug-of oil shall-not lack, until the-day YHWH gives rain upon the-face-of the-earth.'"
- **LOGOS**: For thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, 'The jar of flour shall not be spent, and the jug of oil shall not be empty, until the day that the LORD sends rain upon the earth.'"
- **PNEUMA**: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'The flour jar will not run out and the oil jug will not run dry until the day the LORD sends rain on the land.'"
- **SOPHIA ruling**: LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus with minor adjustments.

— SOPHIA
